sql: SELECT round(avg(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-25'), 4) AS value, round(avg(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'), 4) AS baseline FROM orders.orders o JOIN orders.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
